title: LFP extraction parameters
description: The minimal set of parameters exposed by the LFP extraction pipeline.

filter_family.description: The filter design family forwarded to SpikeInterface as the ftype.

filter_band.description: The (freq_min, freq_max) bandpass edges in Hz.

filter_order.description: The filter order forwarded to SpikeInterface as filter_order.

filter_direction.description: A single forward (causal) pass or a forward-backward (zero-phase) pass.

reference_scheme.description: The re-referencing scheme applied after filtering.

resample_target_fs.description: The target sampling frequency in Hz after resampling.

spatial_factor.description: The spatial decimation factor. 1 keeps every channel, 4 keeps every fourth by depth.

bad_channel_method.description: The SpikeInterface bad channel detection method. Detected channels are removed before filtering.
